title: Jacobi symbol on natural casts
statement: For every positive natural number $N$ and every natural number $A$, the Jacobi symbol viewed as a residue class modulo $N$ at the residue class of $A$ equals the residue class modulo $N$ of the integer-valued Jacobi symbol of $A$ and $N$.
